recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆遠大於周圍細胞的巨噬細胞，淡藍色細胞質充滿纖維狀、像揉皺紙張般的紋路，單一小核偏位，周圍是正常成熟中的造血細胞，是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Single giant histiocyte with elongated outline, many times the size of surrounding myeloid cells
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine wavy fibrillary striations (crumpled tissue paper appearance)
One small round-to-oval nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
No cytoplasmic vacuoles or phagocytosed cells
Background of maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and an eosinophil
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background of normal maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A single giant histiocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm exhibiting fine fibrillary, wrinkled striations and a small round nucleus is present. There is no hemophagocytosis or foamy vacuolation. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; the diagnosis of Gaucher disease should be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase assay and GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma, thalassemia, or mycobacterial infection look identical but have normal enzyme activity and an underlying disorder.
Niemann-Pick cells contain uniform lipid vacuoles producing a soap-bubble cytoplasm, not fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green ceroid granules rather than a striated cytoplasmic texture.
